overpromise.instructions: Some text this ticket tells the product to show the user (copy, labels, cost or price notices, tooltips, messages) claims a capability, cost or behavior that the work described in this same ticket does not deliver yet.

limits_defined.instructions: Every limit, threshold or boundary the ticket mentions (minimum, maximum, first or last element, empty input) has its expected behavior stated explicitly, for every element it applies to.

failure_defined.instructions: The ticket states what the user sees or what the system does when its main action fails, is not allowed, or receives invalid input.

result_precision.instructions: How precisely the ticket defines the result a user can observe when the work is done
criteria: Vague: several different implementations would all fit the text
Mostly defined: the main result is clear but some observable details are left open
Precise: one observable result, each acceptance criterion answerable yes or no
